'''''Legacy of the Force: Tempest''''' is the third novel and the second paperback in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series. It is written by [[Troy Denning]] and was released on November 28, [[2006]] in paperback, though a hardcover edition was printed by the [[Science Fiction Book Club]]. It begins one week after the end of the events in ''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''. The [[Legacy of the Force: Tempest (abridged audiobook)|audiobook]] was narrated by [[Marc Thompson]]. The cover features Hapan Queen Mother [[Tenel Ka Djo]].
